page_title: Vercel & Cloudflare deploy status in your Mac menu bar

summary.name: Deploylight
summary.one_liner: Deploylight is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app that shows Vercel deployments and Cloudflare Workers Builds in one list and updates status as they build, succeed, or fail.
use_cases: Watch Vercel builds from the Mac menu bar without opening a dashboard
Track Cloudflare Workers Builds alongside Vercel deployments
See whether a recent deploy succeeded or failed at a glance
Filter deployments by branch, production or preview, and state
Monitor deployments across several Vercel teams and projects
summary.what_it_does: Deploylight polls Vercel and Cloudflare for deployment status and updates the menu bar icon as builds run, succeed, or fail, checking more often while a build is in progress. Vercel deployments and Cloudflare Workers Builds appear together in one list, newest first, and either provider can be used alone. Filters let you choose teams, projects, accounts, and Workers, and narrow results by branch, production or preview, and deployment state. Setup uses API tokens pasted into Preferences, after which the app lists the available teams, projects, accounts, and Workers to pick from. The app is built with Swift and SwiftUI, and the page says it is code-signed and notarized.
notable: Combines Vercel deployments and Cloudflare Workers Builds in one menu bar list
Polls faster while a build is running
Built with Swift and SwiftUI, code-signed and notarized
Open source under the MIT License, formerly Vercel Deployment Menu Bar
caveats: Cloudflare Pages is not supported yet; only Workers that build from a Git repository with Workers Builds are shown
Needs a Vercel and/or Cloudflare API token to work
